_om: Leppeleseren in English (The Lip Reader, rusj.no/en/lip-reader/) – one player wears headphones with loud music from the phone and reads the other's lips. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Én leser, én lytter. Bytt på!: One reads, one listens. Take turns!
Skru ned hvis det gjør vondt – musikken: Turn it down if it hurts – the music only needs to drown out your voice.
Én har hodetelefoner med høy musikk fra: One of you wears headphones with loud music from the phone – and has to read your lips. You need: headphones for the phone (wired or Bluetooth).
Lytteren kobler hodetelefonene til mobil: The listener plugs the headphones into the phone and puts them on. The phone plays loud party music that drowns out everything. Turn it down if it hurts – the music only needs to drown out your voice.
Leseren ser frasen på skjermen og sier d: The reader sees the phrase on the screen and says it with big, clear mouth movements. Saying it out loud is fine – the music drowns it out. No gestures and no writing in the air!
Lytteren gjetter høyt. Trykk «Riktig!» n: The listener guesses out loud. Tap «Correct!» when the phrase is guessed, or «Skip». You have 60 s to get as many as you can.
Alle mot alle: Leseren og lytteren får e: Everyone for themselves: the reader and the listener each get a point for every phrase. Then the listener reads to the next player. Teams: the team gets the points, and you take turns to read.
Start med lav lyd og skru opp til lytter: Start quiet and turn it up until the listener can't hear your voice – no louder.
Legg mobilen mellom dere med skjermen mo: Put the phone between you with the screen facing the reader.
Sa noen nesten riktig? Dere bestemmer se: Nearly right? You decide what counts.
Bruker dere egen musikk? Slå av musikken: Using your own music? Turn off the music in the game.
One of you hears only music.
Del dere i lag på minst to. Lagene bytte: Split into teams of at least two. The teams take turns to read and listen.
Each player reads to the next one on the list.
Everyone reads and listens once per round.
Each team has one turn per round.
Et lag med sus under musikken – overdøve: A layer of hiss under the music – drowns out voices even better.
Lytteren tar på hodetelefonene. Legg mob: The listener puts the headphones on. Put the phone between you, with the screen facing the reader.
{lytter} tar på hodetelefonene. Legg mob: {lytter} puts the headphones on. Put the phone between you, with the screen facing {leser}.
Musikken er av. Bruk egen musikk i hodet: The music is off. Use your own music in the headphones, or pick a style.
Frasen er skjult. Fortsett når dere er k: The phrase is hidden. Carry on when you're ready.
Si det med store munnbevegelser: Say it with big mouth movements
New record! The old one was {n}.
Skru opp musikken og prøv igjen!: Turn the music up and try again!
You can always start a new one.
You'll go straight to the results.
